notes.title: Kamla - Development Update [Graphics and Lighting]
notes.content:
The development of kamla has been accelerating in past few months, based on the feedback we have gotten from the community we have improved the graphics of the game in a major way with better post process and detailed lighting work. 

We have taken the approach of making things scarier and taking everything to a spookier level with a darker lighting direction.
Below are some new screenshots, feel free to comment and share what you think.
